'Skip to Loafer 2nd Season' Reveals New Staff, Second Teaser Promo, Spring 2027 Premiere
The official website for the Skip to Loafer 2nd Season (Skip and Loafer Season 2) television anime revealed new staff and a second teaser promotional video on Sunday. Produced by P.A.Works, the second season adapting Misaki Takamatsu's coming-of-age manga will premier in April 2027. Staff Director: Kotomi Deai (Natsume Yuujinchou Go) Series Composition: Kotomi Deai, Youko Yonaiyama (Yubisaki to Renren) NEW Character Design: Manami Umeshita (Kaoru Hana wa Rin to Saku sub character design) Ch...
